title: Tissue Freezing for seqFISH
author: Nina Dar

steps_raw.instruction: Tissue fixation and freezing in OCT
prepare dry ice with EtOH for freezing – place dry ice in a cold-prof container. Pour 100% EtOH on the ice
Prepare another closed container with dry ice for the ready-frozen-samples
Prepare stickers with the identifying details on the sample. Stick those on a piece of foil
Take the sample using tweezers or if the sample is small – using a glass pipette in which the thin edge was broken off so that the sample will not get stuck
Place sample in the mold and cover with OCT until the mold is completely full!

Take the mold with tweezes and place is gently in the EtOH – keep holding the mold with tweezers until it is completely frozen! Do not dump it in the EtOH. When holding it, make sure that only the bottom side of the mold is touching the EtOH.
After the sample is frozen, let it float on the EtOH until all samples are done, keeping it is completely frozen (or move to the closed container with the dry ice..).
Once the samples are frozen, cover with foil and transfer on ice/in the container with dry ice to -80
